text:
Dmitry Orlov is 35, a Stanley Cup winner from the 2018 Capitals, and right now the man who runs San Jose's power play from the point. Ten of his 17 points have come with the extra man, which is the whole shape of his season: a heavy shot (85th percentile by top speed) and a passer's eye on the one unit where the Sharks get room to breathe.

At five on five it's harder going. San Jose takes about 43% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice, and his relative number is in the red. Our talent range has his true scoring rate well below the 2.15 points per 60 he's running at, and his 11.5% shooting is nearly double his usual, so expect the pace to cool even if the role holds.

What still works: Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him stopping 15% of entries aimed at him last season against a typical 11%. Watch whether opponents keep dumping the puck away from his side.
headline: Orlov's season runs through the power play
